$comment: Hero cars, European. Same rule as the JDM roster: the silhouette is exact and the lamps,
mirrors and bumpers are deliberately wrong, so the car is unmistakable and is not the car.
Cars whose entire fame is their pop-up headlamps are therefore asked for fixed ones — that is
the single most effective lever here, because a pop-up era wedge with flush lamps reads as a
period-correct sibling of the real thing rather than a bad copy of it.
Paint words are checked against BOTH despills before a GPU is spent: yellow goes on magenta,
purple goes on green. style.mjs picks; it is not a matter of taste.
